name: What types of tile are best for bathroom walls?
description: Ceramic and porcelain tiles are popular for bathroom walls due to durability and water resistance. Consider PEI rating and water absorption when choosing.

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best for bathroom walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic and porcelain tiles are commonly chosen for bathroom walls due to their durability, water resistance, and wide range of styles. Other options include natural stone, glass, or mosaic tiles, each offering unique aesthetics and maintenance requirements. When selecting, consider the tile's Porcelian Enamel Institute (PEI) rating for durability, especially in high-traffic areas, and its water absorption rate for bathroom suitability. Hometelligent Inc. can guide you through options available in your service area, considering your aesthetic preferences and practical needs.
